name: Superpowers development
description: Example workflow built on the Superpowers skills (obra/superpowers): brainstorm a design, write a plan, implement it with TDD, verify, request and handle code review, and finish the branch, with human approvals at the milestones.
author: AI Center

inputs.name: idea
inputs.label: What to build
inputs.description: The feature, change or problem to work on

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Relevant files or folders
inputs.description: Optional: paths or globs to read as context, comma-separated (e.g. src/billing/, docs/architecture/)

nodes.title: Brainstorm the design
nodes.deliverable: Design document with the chosen approach

nodes.title: Approve the design
nodes.instructions: Answer the open questions and confirm (or change) the chosen approach before planning.

nodes.title: Write the implementation plan
Approve the plan
nodes.instructions: Check that the tasks are small, ordered and testable.

nodes.title: Implement with TDD
nodes.deliverable: Code and tests on a branch, with the verification commands run and their output

nodes.title: Code review
nodes.instructions:
Review the implementation against the plan and the design. The first line must be APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED.

{{implementation}}

nodes.title: Review approved?
nodes.question: Did the reviewer give the APPROVED verdict (no blocking findings)?

nodes.title: Finish the branch
nodes.instructions: Run the full test suite once more, then present the integration options (merge, PR, keep or discard) with a PR description ready.

nodes.title: Choose how to integrate
nodes.instructions: Pick merge, PR, keep or discard. Nothing is pushed or merged without this approval.

nodes.title: Work integrated
nodes.deliverable: Branch merged or Pull Request opened

nodes.text: 🦸 Skills from obra/superpowers (MIT, Jesse Vincent). Works best with an agentic provider (claude-code or copilot) so the steps can run tests and git in your repository: --provider claude-code --cwd ../my-repo
